subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To turn one's coat

options.text: A person who changes from one opinion to an opposite one

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"to turn one's coat"** means to change one's loyalty or opinion to an opposite one. (अपनी वफादारी या राय बदलना) • **Example: **He **turned his coat **when he realized his old political party had no chance of winning the election. • **"A person who changes from one opinion to an opposite one"** accurately reflects the meaning of **"to turn one's coat".** (एक व्यक्ति जो एक राय से विपरीत राय में बदल जाता है) • **Example: **During the debate, **she turned her coat** and supported the policies she had once opposed. • Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings: • **To leave without informing** (बिना बताए छोड़ देना): This phrase means to depart from a place without giving notice. • **Example: **He left without informing anyone, causing much confusion. • **To sell old clothes** (पुराने कपड़े बेचना): This phrase refers to the act of selling one's used garments. • **Example: **She decided to sell old clothes to make some extra money. • **To lose one's humanity** (अपनी मानवता खो देना): This phrase means to behave in an exceptionally cruel or inhuman manner. • **Example: **Amidst the chaos of war, many soldiers seemed to lose their humanity. 36:Tc9d, The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
